fields.claim: The tube's hail stress uses a shallow-shell-on-foundation reading of a cylinder, a static contact pressure (fluid or Shi-calibrated), no dynamic amplification, and the 14 mm Hexoloy tube data without size scaling. Birds, timber debris and tool drops on the tubes are not scored. No SiC tube impact test was found.
fields.needed_to_ground: Ice-ball tests on a 275 mm, 1.14 mm-wall SiC tube.
